title: Incident reports
blurb: Something happened here that should be on the record.

questions.label: What kind of incident was it?
options: Something unsafe that has not caused harm yet

questions.label: Where did it happen?
questions.help: The area, the room, the machine — however people here would say it.

questions.label: What is your part in this?
Did anybody need treatment?
options: They went to a doctor or hospital

questions.label: Has it been made safe since?
questions.help: If not, say so in your account below — that is the part somebody needs to act on today.

questions.label: Tell us what happened
questions.help: In your own words. What led up to it, what happened, and what happened next.

questions.label: Do you have photos, video or documents of this?
questions.help: Nothing is uploaded by answering this. It only tells us something exists, so we can ask you for it if it turns out to matter.

questions.label: What is it of?
questions.help: One line. 'A photo of the guard rail', or 'the shift sheet for that day'.
